note: Metatag Webform adds per-webform meta tags. It has no global configure route, no permissions of its own (access is Webform 'update' via _entity_access), no Drush, no services, and no config schema of its own. The Metatags tab (route metatag_webform.settings_form at /admin/structure/webform/manage/{webform}/metatags) saves a metatag_defaults config entity with id webform.<webform_id> (config metatag.metatag_defaults.webform.<id>). metatag_webform_metatags_alter() merges those tags on the webform canonical route; hook_entity_delete/hook_uninstall clean up webform.* defaults. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real webform.<id> metatag_defaults entities on namespaced mtwf_* webforms.

evals.prompt: I installed the Metatag Webform module. Where in the admin UI do I set the meta tags for a specific webform, and does it add a site-wide settings page?
evals.expected_output: There is no global settings page. Open a webform's Settings, then the Metatags secondary tab at /admin/structure/webform/manage/<webform_id>/metatags (route metatag_webform.settings_form), fill in the Metatag fields and Save.

evals.prompt: Where does the Metatag Webform module store the meta tags I enter for a webform? Name the config entity type and the id/config-name pattern.
evals.expected_output: It stores them as a metatag_defaults config entity with id webform.<webform_id> (config name metatag.metatag_defaults.webform.<webform_id>), reusing Metatag's own defaults entity type and schema.

evals.prompt: How does the Metatag Webform module get a webform's custom meta tags onto the rendered page, and what happens to those tags if I delete the webform?
evals.expected_output: metatag_webform_metatags_alter() runs on the webform canonical route (entity.webform.canonical); if an enabled webform.<id> metatag_defaults exists it merges its tags into the page metatags. Deleting the webform removes the webform.<id> defaults via hook_entity_delete(), and uninstalling the module deletes all webform.* defaults.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a webform 'mtwf_known' that has custom meta tags configured via Metatag Webform. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the exact Page title meta tag value set for it.
evals.expected_output: The title tag is 'Contact Acme Support', stored in metatag.metatag_defaults.webform.mtwf_known under tags.title.

evals.prompt: The webform 'mtwf_stat' has a Metatag Webform metatag_defaults entity. Inspect the live configuration and state whether its metatags are currently enabled (active) or disabled.
evals.expected_output: They are disabled: metatag.metatag_defaults.webform.mtwf_stat has status: false, so its tags are not merged onto the webform page.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a webform with machine id 'mtwf_task'. Using the Metatag Webform module, set a meta Description for this webform that mentions 'Acme', and apply it to the live site so it would be output on the webform's page.
evals.expected_output: A metatag_defaults entity webform.mtwf_task exists with a non-empty description tag containing 'Acme' (config metatag.metatag_defaults.webform.mtwf_task, tags.description). E.g. MetatagDefaults::create(['id'=>'webform.mtwf_task',...])->set('tags',['description'=>'...Acme...'])->setStatus(TRUE)->save().

evals.prompt: I have a webform (machine name mtwf_title) and I want its browser/search title to read something specific instead of the default. Using the Metatag Webform feature, give this webform its own Page title meta tag and make sure the setting is turned on. Save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An enabled metatag_defaults entity webform.mtwf_title exists with a non-empty title tag (config metatag.metatag_defaults.webform.mtwf_title, status true, tags.title set).
